## Activity

During February 2021, River Outreach recorded 19 captures. This represents the activity reported for the site during the month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the 19 captures, 4 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 21.1 per cent. This result should be reviewed alongside the operational experience at the site, particularly where image capture has been affected by recurring camera issues.

The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues continue to be logged with the service desk. Maintaining a clear record of these issues will support follow-up and help identify any ongoing equipment or process concerns.

## Grading

A total of 1 capture was graded referable. The median grading lag was 0. Together, the grading result and the median lag provide a summary of the reported assessment activity for River Outreach during February 2021.
